lots.description: Lot 9 reference-check appendices (PSQ). This document contains Appendix 1 (Reference Form) and Appendix 2 (cover letter to referees). It does not enumerate technical specification content, product requirements, or scored evaluation weightings; it defines only the referee-facing quality-view categories used during PSQ reference checking for Lot 9.
requirements: Applicants must provide contact details of a referee for whom the applicant has delivered comparable services (Appendix 1, Part A).
Referees must return the completed Part B reference form to Procurement@bexley.gov.uk by 18th May 2026 by 5pm; references must not be returned to the applicant.

warnings.message: Document content is an administrative PSQ reference appendix (reference questionnaire form plus cover letter to referees). It does not contain primary tender-specification requirements, product requirements, technical standards, or scored evaluation model weightings for Lot 9. Lot 9 context is identified by the in-document heading only.
No product, goods, quantity, or material specifications are present in this document; product_requirement_seeds is intentionally empty.
No standards references (e.g. EN, BS, ISO, CIBSE, safety codes) are present in the extracted markdown for this document.

No CPV codes are cited inside the document body. Notice-level CPV hints on the parent process (50700000-2 Repair and maintenance of building installations; 50750000-7 Lift-maintenance services; 71315000-9 Building services) were not echoed in this document, so cpv_codes is left empty to avoid attributing unanchored claims to the document.
The referee evaluation criteria use a qualitative 5-point tick scale (failed/met/exceeded) rather than numeric weightings. No percentage or points weighting is stated in this document.

Part B references a return deadline of '18th May 2026 by 5pm' for the reference form; this is the reference-check return deadline, not the tender submission deadline. Appendix 2 cover letter also contains a placeholder '****INSERT DATE & TIME****' indicating template text.

Resolved document_role is 'technical_specification' and overlay 'pdf-extraction/tender-specification' was bound, but the document body is a PSQ reference appendix. Downstream routing may wish to reclassify this role. Extraction proceeded conservatively with a single Lot 9 row and no product/requirement seeds.
